author: Aaronjacobs000
summary: This parser reads Hudu alert webhooks for Record created/updated/deleted and One-time shared password reveal. Hudu posts them to bridges/webhook-relay in this repo, which forwards the body to HTTP Ingest. Both alert types go to CloudAudit.
notes:
Setup:
- The payloads in README.md are built from Hudu's documented webhook variables.
- A Hudu webhook has no header setting, so post it to bridges/webhook-relay in this repo, which forwards the body to a Sophos NG-SIEM HTTP Ingest integration with Authorization: Bearer <integration key>.

Field mapping:
- Both alert types go to CloudAudit: record changes with the record type and action, the user and the company, and guest reveals of one-time shared passwords with the guest's address.

Time:
- Hudu sends no event time, so the event time is the ingest time.

Made up in the samples:
- Samples are made up in the README payloads.

Testing:
- Passed Run Test in a lab tenant on 2026-10-13: 29 of 29 fields matched the emulator, and the engine set the event time to the ingest time as expected.
- No built-in parser claimed these lines in 5 Run Tests.

Known gaps:
- Hudu's full activity log is API only, with the reference inside each instance, so it isn't covered.
